title: Remove plaintext secrets from version control and rotate all credentials
acceptance_criteria: .env is added to .gitignore and removed from git tracking
.env.example is created with placeholder values only
All existing secrets are rotated (new keys generated)
CI/CD pipeline injects real secrets via environment variables
Pre-commit hook for secret detection is installed and functional
git-secrets or similar scanning is configured in CI/CD
validation_steps: git ls-files .env confirms file is no longer tracked
Run `git log --all --diff-filter=A -- .env` to confirm .env removal from history (or use git-filter-repo)
CI/CD pipeline fails a build if a secret pattern is detected in a PR
Verify new API keys authenticate successfully with each service
rollback_plan: Restore .env from a secure backup if needed for local development; re-add to .gitignore
